lib-again.choice: One project per demo: Continue or Start over

lib-fly.choice: Fly, with a Live turns switch

lib-hero.note: Steps won’t always be sequential, so I think about it as much as tasks/outcomes/goals as actual steps, but I think that the steps are the right level of granularity to show. We may want optionality in the future for imagery.

lib-layout.choice: One big spotlight, then a grid
lib-layout.note: I think we will have 4-6 hero skills (like intent shaping, problem discovery, etc), which should be shown, and many many “utility” skills (like persona builder, scenario builder, etc) that will not be shown — so the skills will need some kind of metadata field to show, and another for ordering (they should be shown in rough order of their sequence in the product development lifecycle)

lib-templates.choice: Out of the Library, into the Hangar

lib-work.choice: One per workflow, plus optional extra starters
